title: Restriction of a Boolean function
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a function from the sign cube $\\{−1,1\\}^n$ to $\\{−1,1\\}$, and assign each coordinate one of the statuses free, fixed to $1$, or fixed to $-1$. The restricted function on $\\mathbb F_2^n$ evaluates $f$ at the sign vector obtained by completing that coordinate restriction using the input bits.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on $n$ sign coordinates
a restriction status is assigned to every coordinate
